newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resid prices mostly firm, HSFO slides.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resid prices mostly firm, HSFO slides.

text.p: U.S. spot fuel oil prices, helped by firm crude and gas markets, mostly firmed Thursday in sluggish trade, but high sulphur lost ground on prospects for growing U.S. Gulf Coast supplies, industry sources said.

"The market seems pretty well-supported. No one wants to give up barrels right now with colder weather ahead. But high sulphur is off because of excess production in the Gulf," said one cash trader, referring to news of a refinery fire in Louisiana that could mean more HSFO on the market.
In New York Harbor, physical one percent firmed a quarter to $22.25-50 a barrel, traders said.
